parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target CHEMBL5162. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter assays by organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return results as compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
